cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: Directly concatenates user-controlled input (node.getFirstChild().getLiteral()) with newTabLabel without proper HTML escaping, potentially allowing XSS if the link text contains malicious content

While input is escaped with escapeHtml4, the method stores localizedNewWindowLabel in ThreadLocal without validation/escaping, which is later used in aria-label attribute construction without proper context-aware escaping
